title: Sell Mineral Rights in Wellsboro, PA
metaTitle: Sell Mineral Rights in Wellsboro, PA | Tioga County Dry Gas
metaDescription: Wellsboro, Tioga County mineral owner? We buy dry-gas Marcellus interests directly in northern PA, with an honest lease review before any offer.
heroLead: Wellsboro is the Tioga County seat, sitting over some of the most productive dry-gas Marcellus ground in the northeastern part of the play.
intro: Northern Pennsylvania's dry gas counties tell a different story than the wet gas fairway further southwest, and Wellsboro is right at the center of that story for Tioga County. This is gas that comes out mostly methane, without the ethane and propane that add extra value down south, but the wells here have often been some of the most consistent producers in the whole play.
We've talked to enough Tioga County families to know the leasing wave here hit a little later than it did in Washington County, which changes what a lot of local leases actually look like on paper.

sections.heading: Dry Gas Doesn't Mean Low Value
paragraphs: Wellsboro sits in a part of the Marcellus known for exceptionally high initial production rates, even without the liquids premium that wet gas counties get. Operators including Seneca Resources, part of National Fuel, and formerly Shell and Anadarko have drilled extensively in this part of Tioga County, and some of the wells here rank among the strongest producers anywhere in Pennsylvania.
We evaluate your interest based on your unit's actual production, not on whether the gas happens to be wet or dry, because dry gas ground here has held up better than a lot of people assume.

sections.heading: County Seat, Courthouse Advantage
paragraphs: Being the county seat, Wellsboro has the Tioga County recorder of deeds right in town, which makes confirming title on a local interest more straightforward than it is for some of the county's more remote parcels. We still do full chain-of-title work, but proximity to the courthouse tends to speed up that process.
If your family's Wellsboro-area interest passed through several generations without much paperwork tracking it, we can usually reconstruct that history from records held right here.

sections.heading: What Deductions Look Like on a Dry Gas Well
paragraphs: Post-production deduction language works the same way here as it does statewide under Pennsylvania's Guaranteed Minimum Royalty Act: costs for gathering, compression, and marketing come out before your net royalty is calculated, as long as the check stays above one-eighth net. Dry gas wells with strong initial production can sometimes mask how much those deductions are actually costing an owner over time, simply because the raw production numbers look impressive.
We break the math down clearly so you can see what your actual net payment reflects, beyond the headline production figures alone.

faqs.question: Is dry gas worth less than wet gas in Pennsylvania?
faqs.answer: Dry gas generally sells for less per unit than liquids-rich wet gas, but strong initial production rates in parts of Tioga County have made some dry gas wells highly productive overall. We evaluate based on your specific unit's actual numbers.

faqs.question: Which operators have been active near Wellsboro?
faqs.answer: Seneca Resources, part of National Fuel, along with historical activity from Shell and Anadarko, have developed significant acreage in this part of Tioga County.

faqs.question: My family's lease is old and the paperwork is incomplete. Can you help?
faqs.answer: Yes. Being the county seat, Wellsboro has convenient access to Tioga County deed records, which helps us reconstruct incomplete ownership history efficiently.
